control_failures.control_label: controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels

facts.title: fire on TK-7103 during a statutory inspection

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on TK-7103 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on TK-7103 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically bunding, drainage and spill containment. TK-7103 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 16 September 2004 an incident occurred on TK-7103 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during a statutory inspection, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
